_about: Contra (USA) RAM addresses the harness uses. 'fields' = bytes the bridge reports with every state line (contra/emulator.py load_fields). 'map' = everything verified on day 1 by watching it in BizHawk/NesHawk, with how it was verified; see ram_notes.md. Names in CAPS are the disassembly's labels (knowledge/ram_map.md has the full list read from the code).

game_mode.label: GAME_ROUTINE_INDEX
game_mode.values: 0 title init, 1 title/menu, 2 attract demo, 3 start pressed (waits for the jingle), 4 one-frame clear, 5 in a level, 6 ending
game_mode.verified: watched: 0 -> 1 on frame 10, 1 -> 3 on frame 12 (Start), 3 -> 4 on 339, 4 -> 5 on 340; 1 -> 2 (demo) when nothing is pressed; 6 after the heart (stage-8 run)

level_routine.label: LEVEL_ROUTINE_INDEX
level_routine.values: 0 load, 1 stage card, 2 score screen (192 frames), 3 draws the first screen, 4 play, 8 boss destroyed (player still in control), 9 scripted exit (controller zeroed), 5 next level, 6/7 game over screens, 10 game-over delay

end_level_subroutine.label: END_LEVEL_ROUTINE_INDEX
end_level_subroutine.verified: 0 -> 1 on the frame after control is lost (on the ground), -> 2 for the final delay, -> 0

stage.label: CURRENT_LEVEL
stage.verified: 0 -> 1 on frame 4319 (reference run); 7 -> 9 after the heart; writing it on frame 340 makes the game load that stage (debug only)

room_or_screen.label: LEVEL_SCREEN_NUMBER
room_or_screen.values: screen index of the scroll; in a base = room index
room_or_screen.verified: stage 1: 0..12 (boss wall on screen 12, offset 0); base 1: 0 -> 1 -> 2 -> 3 on the 4th walk-in step of each room

scroll_in_screen.label: LEVEL_SCREEN_SCROLL_OFFSET
scroll_in_screen.verified: +1 per scrolled pixel, wraps to 0 exactly when $64 increments; equals $FD on every play frame of stage 1; base rooms: counts the 4 walk-in steps 0..3

frame_scroll.label: FRAME_SCROLL
frame_scroll.verified: equals the scroll step of the frame on 3299 of 3303 play frames; never more than 1 in stage 1

frame_counter.label: FRAME_COUNTER
frame_counter.verified: +1 on every one of 4587 non-lag frames, unchanged on every one of 33 lag frames (reference run, frames 1-4621); keeps counting while paused

rng.label: RANDOM_NUM
rng.verified: changes on 4567 of 4620 frames, all 256 values seen; differs between NesHawk and quickerNES from frame 12 on with identical inputs; changes after any change of what happens in a frame (an extra bullet, a pause)

lag.verified: BizHawk's lag flag (no controller poll) is set on exactly the frames on which $1A does not advance. $1B (NMI_CHECK) reads 1 after 31 of the 33 lag frames and 0 otherwise. Lag seen only at power-on and stage loads, plus one frame when the boss is destroyed (3832)

pause.label: PAUSE_STATE
pause.verified: 1 from the frame a new Start press is read until the frame the next new Start press is read; x/scroll frozen meanwhile; $1A keeps counting; the frame of the un-pause runs normal logic with that frame's buttons

controller_seen.label: CONTROLLER_STATE
controller_seen.bits: A 80, B 40, Select 20, Start 10, Up 08, Down 04, Left 02, Right 01
controller_seen.verified: equals the input sent on 3294 of 3301 play frames; on the others it is the previous frame's byte or lacks the newly pressed button (NesHawk only: see ram_notes.md, 'ignored controller frames'); zeroed by the game from the frame after control is lost at a stage end

controller_new.label: CONTROLLER_STATE_DIFF
controller_new.verified: bit set only on the first frame a button is seen

player_state.label: PLAYER_STATE
player_state.values: 0 not in play / dropping-in init, 1 normal, 2 dead
player_state.verified: 0 -> 1 on L+1 (592); 1 -> 2 on the frame $B4 bit 0 is set; 2 -> 0 -> 1 on respawn

player_x.label: SPRITE_X_POS
player_x.verified: screen X; +1 per frame with Right seen until 128, then the screen scrolls instead (2986 frames scroll, 65 frames x+1); the PPU draws sprite tiles at (x, y) one frame later on 3210 of 3303 frames checked (the rest: sprite flicker / hidden)

player_y.label: SPRITE_Y_POS
player_y.verified: drop-in from 32, ground 100 at the start of stage 1; base rooms ground 168; death below ~232

pose.label: PLAYER_SPRITE_SEQUENCE
pose.values: outdoor: 0 standing, 1 gun up, 2 prone, 3 running or jump curl, 4 dying; base: 0 facing the wall, 3 strafing, 6 dying
pose.verified: Up held on the ground = 1, Down = 2, nothing = 0, Right = 3 (0 on the first frame); jump = 3; the END event is 1 -> 0 / 2 -> 0

aim.label: PLAYER_AIM_DIR
aim.values: 0 up (facing right), 1 up-right, 2 right, 3 down-right, 4 prone right; 6, 7 seen facing left (7 = left forward: UNVERIFIED which is which)

sprite_code.label: PLAYER_SPRITE_CODE (copied to $0300)
sprite_code.verified: 15 standing gun forward, 22 gun up, 23 prone, 8/9 jump curl frames, 2-6 run cycle (stage 8 and stage 1 observations)

jump_status.label: PLAYER_JUMP_STATUS
jump_status.verified: low nibble 1 from the frame after a new A press on the ground (16 of 17 presses; the 17th was an ignored controller frame) until landing; high nibble seen 0, 1, 2, 3

weapon.label: P1_CURRENT_WEAPON
weapon.values: low nibble 0 default, 1 M, 2 F, 3 S, 4 L; bit 4 = Rapid
weapon.verified: stage 1 pickups in order: $00 -> $01 (M) -> $11 (+R) -> $03 (S, Rapid lost) -> $02 (F) -> $03 (S) -> $13 (+R); kept across the stage change ($13 at the start of stage 2)

lives.label: P1_NUM_LIVES
lives.verified: spare lives: 2 from frame 340; +1 on frame 3835 when the score ($07E2/3, in hundreds) passed 200, next threshold ($3C/$3D) became 500; -1 per death; game over ($38 = 1) when a death comes at 0; the HUD shows min(lives, 4) medals

new_life_invincibility.label: NEW_LIFE_INVINCIBILITY_TIMER
new_life_invincibility.verified: 127 on L+1, -1 per frame, 0 on frame L+128 (719 in stage 1)

barrier_timer.label: INVINCIBILITY_TIMER
barrier_timer.verified: NOT observed counting (no Barrier was picked up). Writing $80 every frame (debug) did NOT stop a death in a pit, as expected

death_flag.label: PLAYER_DEATH_FLAG
death_flag.verified: bit 0 set on the frame of a lethal hit; $90 = 2 the same frame

game_over.label: P1_GAME_OVER_STATUS
game_over.verified: 1 after the third death of a 2-spare-life game (tools/try_tas.py runs)

boss_defeated.label: BOSS_DEFEATED_FLAG
boss_defeated.verified: 0; 1 the frame after the boss's HP reaches 0 (stage 1: frame 3836; stage 8 heart); $81 from the frame after control is lost; 2 during the last delay; 0 when the next level loads

delay.label: DELAY_TIME_LOW_BYTE
delay.verified: $C0 counted down on the score screen; $FF while the boss explodes, then counts down to 0; $2C becomes 9 on the frame after it reads 0

hud_flag.label: SPRITE_LOAD_TYPE
hud_flag.verified: 0 -> $FF on the same frame $2C becomes 4 (clock START in RAM); 0 again on the level change

bullets.label: PLAYER_BULLET_SLOT (+i); X $03C8+i, Y $03B8+i, routine $0438+i, timer $0418+i
bullets.verified: non-zero = live bullet; S volley = 5 slots at once, at most 10 live (slots 0-9); a new B press raised the live count on 84 of 110 presses in stage 1 (the rest: no free slot). Slots 12-15 also read non-zero at times - not understood

enemy_slots.label: ENEMY_ROUTINE (+i, 0 = empty); type $0528+i, HP $0578+i, X $033E+i, Y $0324+i, state $0598+i (bit 7 = cannot be hit), timer $0538+i
enemy_slots.verified: watched in base 1 (core type $14: HP 8, state $9F -> $1F when it opens 258 frames after the room loads, HP -1 per hit) and at bosses (below); enemy bullets are type $01

boss_hp.verified: stage 1 wall core type $11: HP 32 (seen with the default gun); stage 8 first boss type $10: HP 102 with S; base wall core type $14: HP 8; base turret type $13: HP 4. Boss HP is an ordinary enemy slot (slot 15 or 10 in what was seen); $3B is set the frame after it reaches 0

base_room_cleared.label: INDOOR_SCREEN_CLEARED
base_room_cleared.verified: 0; 1 about 57 frames after the last core's HP reaches 0; $80 the next frame; Up starts the walk to the next room only from the frame AFTER it reads $80

base_cores_left.label: WALL_CORE_REMAINING
base_cores_left.verified: 1 in base-1 rooms 1-4; 0 about 33 frames after the core's HP reaches 0

base_fence_stun.label: ELECTROCUTED_TIMER
base_fence_stun.verified: 48 when Up is read while $37 is 0

base_advance.label: INDOOR_PLAYER_ADV_FLAG ($73 INDOOR_SCROLL 0/1/2)
base_advance.verified: four walk-in steps of 34 frames each; the room index changes on the 32nd frame of the 4th

sprite_list.label: OAMDMA_CPU_BUFFER
sprite_list.verified: the sprite list the game builds at the end of a frame; the PPU's OAM equals it one frame later (medals, Bill's pose)
